column1: # PTEN (phosphatase and tensin homolog) orthosteric-site residue atlas.
# Numbering: PTEN_HUMAN / UniProt P60484 (403 aa). Residue identities read from the P60484 sequence.
# Source: Xiaotian Liao & Ben Lehner 2026, Nat Commun. Orthosteric sites manually curated from the literature (refs 99-105).
# NOTE: allosteric sites were NOT curated for PTEN in this source -- this file contains only orthosteric (substrate / membrane / cofactor) sites.
# Orthosteric annotations: catalytic loops (arginine loop 35-49; WPD loop 88-98; P loop 123-130; TI loop 159-171),
#   calcium-binding regions (200-212, 226-238, 258-268), Calpha2 loop (327-335), membrane-binding helix (151-174),
#   PI(4,5)P2-binding motif / PBM (1-15). Positions 159-171 fall in both the TI loop (catalytic) and the membrane-binding helix.
# site_class: orthosteric for all rows (no allosteric sites curated). direction blank = structural site annotation only.
# pockets: functional pocket/interface the residue belongs to (catalytic | membrane | calcium | PI(4,5)P2/PBM). region: named loop/element ('|' joins overlapping elements).
# ALLOSTERIC additions (Liao & Lehner 2026, Fig2E): three-star (expert-reviewed) ClinVar PATHOGENIC variants that reside OUTSIDE orthosteric sites,
#   plotted as black triangles in Fig2E and labeled; the paper infers these are loss-of-function via allosteric mechanisms (functional effect not explained by fold destabilization).

#   site_class=allosteric, region=non-orthosteric, direction=inhibitory (LoF). Orthosteric (catalytic/membrane/PBM) rows are unchanged. NOTE: active-site variants C124R & R130G (Fig2C) are ORTHOSTERIC, not added here.
# A 'variant' column has been added (after residue) to record the specific substitution(s); it is blank for structural site rows.
